Separately, in the first few tokens of a text many tokens sit at 0.6-1.0, and a verb right after a short sentence-opening subject ('Officials said', 'The company reported') can reach 1.0-1.6; away from the text start such verbs stay below about 0.8, and the second conjunct is irrelevant.
